messages.text: Hello, is this Dabos printing?
Hi yes, how can we help?
We're Code Academy, we have a graduation for our bootcamp students later this month. We want a gift pack for each student
something like a hoodie, a mug and maybe a medal? what would you suggest
Nice idea 🎓 Hoodie with your logo on the front and the student's name on the back looks really good. Same for the mug. And we can laser engrave the medals with the course name
love it. prices?

Hoodie with name 18 JD
Mug with name 6 JD
Engraved medal 4 JD
ok and it's around 50 students
can you also print the certificates? we have the design ready
Sure, on premium 300g paper, 30 JD for the whole batch
great. let me confirm the final number with the team and send you the names
hi, final number is 45 (5 students didn't finish 😕)
here's the excel with names and hoodie sizes
Got it. So 45 hoodies, 45 mugs, 45 medals + certificates = 1290 JD
Quick question: some names are in Arabic and some in English, do you want them as written?
good catch, all in English please. I'll fix the sheet
updated sheet 👆
Thanks. Hoodie color: black or navy?
navy, it matches our brand
Here's a sample hoodie and medal for approval
looks great! one thing, can the logo on the front be a bit smaller? it's too big on the chest
Sure, made it 8cm instead of 11. Better?
perfect ✅ go ahead
hey sorry, one of the names has a typo: it's Yazan Al-Khatib not Yazen
No problem, his hoodie wasn't printed yet. Fixed 👍
phew thanks 😅
will everything be ready before july 23? that's the ceremony
Yes, we'll finish by July 20 and deliver on the 21st
All done and packed by student name 📦
Total 1290 JD, CliQ to amr2003amr
transferred 1290 JD by CliQ, please confirm
Received ✅ thank you! Delivery tomorrow 10am to the academy
received everything, the boxes look so professional
the students went crazy over the hoodies 😂🎉 thank you Dabos, we'll definitely work with you for the next cohort
Congrats to all of them! Happy to work with you anytime 🤍
